quest.title: Treasure Lost, Treasure Found
quest.description: The Guili Assembly hides some sort of secret...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Unknown Item #59432 x1

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: ...How many secrets does Liyue truly hold?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Great. Hmm, but I should give you an idea of what to look for... Yes, keep your eyes peeled for stone pillars and stone tablets.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Given how ancient these ruins are, any text we can hope to find will be written on stone, not paper.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: After all, stone is the oldest and most durable medium for written communication.

talks.objective: Head to the Guili Assembly to search for an ancient stone tablet.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: ...How many secrets does Liyue truly hold?

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Find anything in the ruins?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I found five stone tablets.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Great! Let's see... Ugh, these are all over the place. Let me see if I can work out the right order...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: ...Hmm, there's a lot of missing text here, so it's quite disjointed. Also, I'm still not sure on the order...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: But anyway, this is my best guess. If I line up like this, it reads as follows:

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: "...In the beginning, when the people assembled to farm the land... A god named Guizhong descended, whose dominion was over Dust, and whose reach shrouded the skies for thousands of miles around..."

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: "...The god laid down four commandments for the people... Then another god descended, whose dominion was over Geo, and who brought the people of Liyue to this place. Jointly they shepherded the people for their protection..."

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: "...And the assembly was named Guili after the names of the two gods..."

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: It seems to be the about history of the Guili Assembly. And of a god with power over dust, who watched over this place.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: But it also mentions another god who came here at some point, and even brought some of their people with them.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Also, it seems to be saying that the name 'Guili,' as in Guili Assembly, came about by taking one syllable each from the names of these two gods.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: How fascinating. In all the documents I've ever read, I've never come across any mention of two gods who coexisted peacefully... let alone who actively worked together...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: It seems they were more than just two allied gods — they were best friends.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: But what happened to them? They can't have just... disappeared?

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: And how was the Guili Assembly laid to waste so completely? With two gods watching over it, no disaster should have been quite so devastating. Natural or otherwise.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Which means that whatever happened was beyond even the gods' power to withstand...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Traveler, could you keep looking for more clues? Unless I'm mistaken, there should be more stone tablets around here, just like the ones you have seen already.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Maybe they will tell the story of what happened next...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: That which is recorded on these stone tablets seems to differ in some places from those in some documents.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: *sigh* So many legends, so many tellings... Which of these is the truth, I wonder...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: *sigh* So many legends, so many tellings... Which of these is the truth, I wonder...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Ah, you're back. I was starting to wonder how much longer I'd have to wait. Found anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Two more stone tablets.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Ooh, let me see!

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: "...and there they fought upon the Guili Plains, where black dust choked the heavens and a thousand rocks splintered..."

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Oh my... It appears to be saying that a battle once took place on the Guili Plains. And an enormous battle at that...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: That must have been the battle in which the Guili Assembly fell. But as for this other passage...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: ...It seems to have been written by someone who couldn't bring themselves to leave their home. So they stayed here. And what's more...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...There's treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: ...Clearly you have a fondness for treasure. But you're not wrong, there is indeed treasure in the Guili Plains if this passage is to be taken literally.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: But then we have... "Guizhong's Four Commandments shall guide those in generations to come who aspire to find it," followed by:

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: "Teach with wisdom, be bound by virtue, fortify the bones, unite in ambition — the convergence of these four shall be known as the 'Guili Assembly.'"

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: How does one decipher that? I wouldn't know where to start.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Let's head back to Wangshu Inn. I think we all need some downtime before we try to tackle the riddle of Guizhong's Four Commandments.
